params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.table
params.description: Required. The table whose rows will be deleted.

params.name: data.key_set
params.description: Required. The primary keys of the rows within [table][google.spanner.v1.Mutation.Delete.table] to delete. The primary keys must be specified in the order in which they appear in the PRIMARY KEY() clause of the table's equivalent DDL statement (the DDL statement used to create the table). Delete is idempotent. The transaction will succeed even if some or all rows do not exist.
